observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a MAXMECH MINI-200 welding machine.
Photo 1 shows the same box stacked on top of a box for a circular saw.
The actual welding machine is not visible in either photo.
The boxes are in a storage or retail environment.
A watermark for 'REWTOLE INTEGRATED SERVICES' is visible on the images.

claims.claim: Its used for welding iron rod,pipe and iron sheet
claims.evidence: No photo of the machine or it being used is provided.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual welding machine outside of the box.

risks.risk: The machine may be in poor physical or functional condition.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the machine from all sides and a video of it powered on.

risks.risk: Essential welding cables (leads) may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing the electrode holder and earth clamp cables.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual welding machine out of the box.
Photos of the welding leads and any other included accessories.
A video of the machine powered on and striking an arc.
response.reason: Only photos of the packaging are provided. Since the seller describes the item as 'used', it is necessary to see the actual condition of the machine and its accessories before a valuation can be made.
